people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
translations.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
